audience: food safety and quality managers who use Safefood 360 for documents, suppliers and complaints

useCases.title: Find document reviews that are due or overdue
useCases.text: The AI lists the review records of controlled documents with an OData filter and sorts them by due date, so you can see which documents need a review.

useCases.title: Review customer complaints
useCases.text: The AI lists complaints with number, risk, date, company, source and product or material, and opens one to read its description.

useCases.title: Check suppliers by approval status and risk
useCases.text: The AI lists suppliers with approval status, risk, contacts and establishment numbers and opens one supplier.

useCases.title: Review materials and a known finished product
useCases.text: The AI lists materials with category, countries of origin and risk, and opens a finished product by its identifier to see its specifications and the materials it is made of.

useCases.title: Record a new customer complaint
useCases.text: The AI records a complaint in Safefood 360. This may start the site's complaint workflow and notifications.

useCases.title: Update a document or a customer record
useCases.text: The AI changes the title, description or folder of a controlled document, or the name, phone and notes of a customer. It does not publish a new version.
